description: Polymarket events (one question with one or several markets, such as an election with many candidates): the busiest open events by 24-hour volume or those matching a search, with volume, liquidity, end date, tags, the number of open markets and the five leading outcomes by price. Use to see who leads a multi-candidate market or to browse what is being traded now. Example: q=president. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

q.description: Optional search, e.g. president 2028; without it the busiest events by 24h volume
